Halloweekend

An informal name for a weekend of Halloween celebrations.

  • Culture
  • Vocabulary

Context

Halloweekend often refers to the weekend on or near Halloween, especially when parties and campus events spread the celebration across several days.

Its exact dates depend on the calendar and on how a group uses the name.

Examples

  • A college group might schedule a costume party and a game night as two parts of Halloweekend.
